name: codePad
author: alexwoo79
description: codePad in the bar: collect the files to typeset, open them in codePad, and export a printable A4 sheet to PDF, HTML or Word without leaving the shell.

barWidget.description: Click opens a panel: add the files to typeset, open them in codePad, or export them to PDF / HTML / DOCX in place. Exports run headless, so no window flashes while a sheet renders.

schema.label: codePad binary
schema.description: Leave empty to use whichever `codepad` the session finds on PATH. The AppImage install (~/.local/bin/codepad) is found the same way.

schema.label: Export directory
schema.description: Where exports are written. Leave empty for the home directory; the panel's own field starts here and remembers what you set.

schema.label: Headless export
schema.description: Run exports with QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen so no codePad window flashes while the sheet renders. Turn off only if your build cannot export without a screen.
